scripts.stack:dev: npm run secrets:init && npm run verify && docker compose -f infra/docker/compose.yml -f infra/docker/compose.dev.yml up -d --build && npm run test:ui
scripts.stack:prod: npm run verify && docker compose -f infra/docker/compose.yml -f infra/docker/compose.prod.yml --env-file infra/docker/.env up -d --build
scripts.db:up: npm run secrets:init && docker compose -f infra/docker/compose.yml -f infra/docker/compose.dev.yml up -d postgres redis
scripts.db:down: docker compose -f infra/docker/compose.yml -f infra/docker/compose.dev.yml stop postgres redis
scripts.test: npm run test:cov -w api && npm run test -w web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w api && npm run arch:check -w api && npm run lint -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w api && npm run typecheck -w web
scripts.verify:ci: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:e2e
scripts.build: npm run verify && npm run build -w api && npm run build -w web
scripts.hooks:install: git config core.hooksPath mukellef-takip/.githooks && echo push öncesi doğrulama kancası kuruldu
